trial_court: Additional District Judge at Durgapur, Burdwan; Fast Track Court at Durgapur, Burdwan
case_name: Smt. Soma Ghosh vs Jayanta Ghosh
facts_of_case: Petitioner/wife has prayed for transfer of the Matrimonial Suit No. 56 of 2014 filed by the opposite party/husband to the Court of the learned District Judge at Alipore, South 24-Parganas.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be expected to travel long distances to contest a suit.
legal_principles.held: She cannot leave the minor daughter back at home, to travel to Durgapur to contest the said matrimonial suit.
cited_cases: Smt. Soma Ghosh vs Jayanta Ghosh on 24 June, 2015

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to travel long distances can be a valid reason for transferring a suit.
legal_principles.held: On the basis of the aforesaid facts, the petitioner has stated that it is impossible for her to undertake the long distance between her present place of residence at Garia to Durgapur to contest the said matrimonial suit before the learned Additional District Judge at Durgapur, Burdwan.
cited_cases: Smt. Soma Ghosh vs Jayanta Ghosh on 24 June, 2015

outcome.final_order: The Matrimonial Suit No. 56 of 2014 filed by the opposite party/husband has been transferred to the Court of the learned District Judge at Alipore, South 24-Parganas.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of case
advising on jurisdictional issues in divorce cases
